errors.evidence: The first major peak of the purple TSE line occurs at the year 1991, not 1990.

errors.text_span: steigt dann auf über 900 im Jahr 2008 an
errors.evidence: The purple TSE line does not rise to over 900 in 2008; at that point, it is in a steep decline and has a value of approximately 600.
The final value of the purple TSE line in 2017 is approximately 500, not 600.
The green TSEC line begins at a value clearly above 600, approximately 650. 'fast 600' (almost 600) is incorrect as it implies a value less than 600.

errors.text_span: bevor sie sich um das Jahr 2000 auf etwa 400 einpendelt
errors.evidence: This misrepresents the trend of the blue TSEB line. The line does not settle at 400 around the year 2000; instead, it continues to rise to a peak of about 550 in 2003 and only settles into the 400-500 range after that peak. The description incorrectly reverses the sequence of events.
